{{Top}}
[[File:Bodyguard_TofG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] bodyguard with [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] client]]
{{Quote|I'm a professional bodyguard. Trust isn't part of the job.|[[Shada D'ukal]]|<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
'''Bodyguards''' were beings hired to protect someone. Many people in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], from [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] down to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], had bodyguards.

Bodyguards were often hired to protect high-risk heads of big corporations, such as [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Most [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] hired bodyguards, as they were big targets for an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] hired by a rival. In the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] often served as bodyguards for [[Senator/Legends|senators]] or the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], up until the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] (later the [[Red Guard]]) took over the protection of the Chancellor. [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] army, had [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] act as his bodyguards. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] could often be found protecting various officials of the Empire. Also, [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] were often hired as bodyguards.

Several members of the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Species/Legends|species]] served as bodyguards for members of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. One Noghri bodyguard, [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]], was [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] bodyguard before Rukh killed Thrawn during the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]]. After the Noghri discovered that Leia Organa Solo was the daughter of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], she was frequently protected by Noghri bodyguards including [[Khabarakh]] and [[Mobvekhar]].
